mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(i.delivery_date, o.delivery_date, #{today}) AS "date", CASE WHEN o.kind = 'PURCHASE' THEN 'PO' ELSE 'SO' END AS "type", o.order_no AS "docNo", CASE WHEN o.kind = 'PURCHASE' THEN i.qty - i.done_qty + i.replenish_qty ELSE -(i.qty - i.done_qty + i.replenish_qty - COALESCE(rv.qty, 0)) END AS "qty" FROM scm_order_item i JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = i.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT source_item_id, SUM(qty) AS qty FROM wms_reservation WHERE source_type = 'SALES' AND qty > 0 GROUP BY source_item_id) rv ON rv.source_item_id = i.id WHERE i.material_id = #{materialId} AND o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL') AND i.qty - i.done_qty + i.replenish_qty > 0 AND (o.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} OR o.warehouse_id IS NULL) ORDER BY 1

SELECT m.id AS "materialId", m.code AS "code", m.name AS "name", m.spec AS "spec", m.unit AS "unit", m.safety_stock AS "safetyStock", m.reorder_point AS "reorderPoint", m.reorder_qty AS "reorderQty", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.qty - s.frozen_qty) FROM wms_stock s JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id WHERE s.material_id = m.id AND w.type NOT IN ('DEFECT', 'CONSIGN_OUT', 'CONSIGN_IN')), 0) AS "available", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.qty - i.done_qty + i.replenish_qty) FROM scm_order_item i JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE i.material_id = m.id AND o.kind = 'PURCHASE' AND o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL') AND i.qty - i.done_qty + i.replenish_qty > 0), 0) AS "poOpen", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.qty - i.done_qty + i.replenish_qty) FROM scm_order_item i JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE i.material_id = m.id AND o.kind = 'SALES' AND o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL') AND i.qty - i.done_qty + i.replenish_qty > 0), 0) AS "soOpen" FROM wms_material m WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.reorder_point IS NOT NULL
AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY m.code
